# Optimize grid.Row, grid.Container, collection.Base, and bigData hot paths

## Context

Following the `neo.mjs@13.3.1` vs `ag-grid-community@36.2.0` (`animateRows={false}`, `vite preview`) benchmark update in [`neomjs/benchmarks#3`](https://github.com/neomjs/benchmarks/pull/3), a line-by-line V-B-A audit of `src/grid/Row.mjs`, `src/grid/Container.mjs`, `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs`, `src/collection/Base.mjs`, `src/data/Store.mjs`, and `examples/grid/bigData/` surfaced seven concrete hot-path bottlenecks during 100k-row × 200-column dataset swaps, filtering, and 2D virtual scrolling.

- **Live latest-open sweep (`ticket-create §1a(i)`):** Checked latest 20 open issues on `neomjs/neo` (`#20114` down to `#19139`) at `2026-10-26T01:01:28Z`; no equivalent found.
- **A2A in-flight claim sweep (`ticket-create §1a(ii)`):** Checked `list_messages({status: 'all', limit: 30})` at `2026-10-26T01:01:14Z`; no overlapping `[lane-claim]` or `[lane-intent]` on `src/grid/*`, `src/collection/*`, or `examples/grid/bigData/*`.
- **Memory Core & KB rationale sweep (`ticket-create §1a(iii)-(iv)`):** Ran `query_raw_memories` (`grid Row createVdom permanent columns collection splice isFilteredItem evaluateFilters bigData performance`), `ask_knowledge_base`, and `gh issue list --state open --assignee @me` (`0` open issues); no prior retraction or duplicate found.

## The Problem

1. **Unconditional `O(rows × totalColumns)` Pass-2 permanent-column loop in `Neo.grid.Row#createVdom` (`src/grid/Row.mjs:564-588`):**
   On every vertical or horizontal scroll frame and every store load, Pass 2 executes `for (i = 0; i < countColumns; i++)` on every visible row, calling `columnPositions.getAt(i)` and `columns.get(columnPosition.dataField)` `200` times per row (`30 rows × 200 columns = 6,000` lookups per frame) to check `if (column.hideMode !== 'removeDom' || column.locked)` — even when zero columns in the grid use permanent mode or locking.
2. **Non-silent `clear()` + `add()` inside `Neo.grid.Container#createColumns` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:962-973`) and leaked `header.Button` instances in `Neo.grid.header.Wrapper#updateHeaders` (`src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs:216-239`):**
   When `grid.columns = newColumns` is assigned at runtime (`me._columns` is already a `Collection` with `listeners: {mutate: me.onColumnsMutate}`), line `963` calls `me._columns.clear()` (firing `onColumnsMutate` #1 with 0 columns, running `createOrUpdateSubGrids()` and a `passSizeToBody()` main-thread `getLayoutRect` IPC round-trip), line `964` calls `me._columns.add(columns)` (firing `onColumnsMutate` #2, running a second `createOrUpdateSubGrids()`, second `passSizeToBody()` IPC round-trip, and `applyColumnButtonOrder()` across 200 columns), and line `970` then calls `me.createOrUpdateSubGrids(lockedStartButtons, centerButtons, lockedEndButtons)` a third time. Furthermore, `Wrapper#updateHeaders` overwrites `headerToolbar.items = centerButtons` without destroying the previous `Neo.grid.header.Button` instances.
3. **Redundant render passes in `examples/grid/bigData/GridContainer.mjs` (`lines 78-80`) and `MainStore.mjs` (`lines 93-129`):**
   `GridContainer#afterSetAmountColumns` sets `this.store.amountColumns = value` before `this.columns = columns`, causing `GridBody` to render the newly generated 200-column records against the old 50 columns before rebuilding the 200 columns. In addition, `MainStore` calls `me.clear(false)` followed by `me.add(data, false)`, firing two separate `mutate` → `load` cycles (the first rendering an empty grid and arming a `50ms` `scrollTo` timer).
4. **100,000 `isFilteredItem` invocations during bulk `Collection#splice` when no filter is `effective` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1597-1630`, `src/data/Store.mjs:1091-1107`):**
   `MainStore` configures two inactive filters (`firstname: null`, `lastname: null`). During `store.add(data, false)` for 100,000 items, `Collection#splice` calls `!me.isFilteredItem(item)` 100,000 times (`Store#isFilteredItem` iterating `me.filters.forEach` 100,000 times and `Collection#isFilteredItem` calling `Filter#isFiltered` 200,000 times) even though `me._filters.some(f => f.effective)` is `false`.
5. **Unconditional `items.slice()` of 100,000 items in `Collection#evaluateFilters` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1161`):**
   `let filtered = items.slice()` clones the 100,000-element array unconditionally right before `if (this.filterMode === 'primitive') { filtered = []; }` discards the clone.
6. **Per-cell `getLogicalCellId` string allocation and `selectedCells.includes()` in `Row#applyRendererOutput` (`src/grid/Row.mjs:302, 467`):**
   Because `selectedCells` defaults to `[]` (`Row.mjs:422`), `if (selectedCells)` is always truthy, allocating `logicalCellId` and calling `.includes()` on every rendered cell even when `selectedCells.length === 0`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.collection.Filter` already exposes a canonical `get effective()` getter (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118`: `!me.disabled && (!!me.filterBy || !(me.includeEmptyValues && (me.value === null || Neo.isEmpty(me.value))))`).
- `Neo.grid.Container#onColumnLockChange` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1209`) already uses `clearSilent()` to avoid double-firing `onColumnsMutate`.

## The Fix

1. **`src/grid/Row.mjs` & `src/grid/Body.mjs`:**
   - Guard Pass 2 in `Row#createVdom` so it only iterates when the grid has permanent (`hideMode !== 'removeDom'`) or locked columns (or iterate a pre-filtered list of permanent column indices).
   - Guard `if (selectedCells?.length > 0)` (at `Row.mjs:302`) and `if (selectedRows?.length > 0 && record)` (at `Row.mjs:467`) before computing `logicalCellId` or calling `.includes()`.
2. **`src/grid/Container.mjs` & `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs`:**
   - In `Container#createColumns` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:962-973`), destroy replaced column instances and update `me._columns` without triggering two premature `onColumnsMutate` passes before `createOrUpdateSubGrids(lockedStartButtons, centerButtons, lockedEndButtons)`.
   - In `Wrapper#updateHeaders` (`src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs:216-239`), destroy replaced `Neo.grid.header.Button` instances before assigning new button configs to `items` and calling `createItems()`.
3. **`src/collection/Base.mjs` & `src/data/Store.mjs`:**
   - In `Collection#splice` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1597-1630`), compute `const hasEffectiveFilters = me._filters.some(f => f.effective)` once before the `for (i = 0; i < len; i++)` loop and only call `me.isFilteredItem(item)` when `hasEffectiveFilters` is true.
   - In `Collection#evaluateFilters` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1161`), only call `items.slice()` in the non-`primitive` branch.
4. **`examples/grid/bigData/GridContainer.mjs` & `MainStore.mjs`:**
   - Use `me.clearSilent()` (and `me.allItems?.clearSilent()`) before `me.add(data, false)` in `MainStore` so dataset swaps emit a single `mutate` → `load` event.
   - Coordinate `GridContainer#afterSetAmountColumns` so column definitions and store data update without rendering the new dataset against stale columns first.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — preserves all existing `Neo.grid`, `Neo.collection`, and `Neo.data.Store` contracts and event semantics while eliminating redundant work in hot paths.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.grid.Row#createVdom` skips Pass 2's `O(countColumns)` loop when no column has `hideMode !== 'removeDom'` or `locked`, while preserving permanent/locked cell rendering when present.
- [ ] `Neo.grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` and `createVdom` skip `getLogicalCellId` and `.includes()` when `selectedCells` / `selectedRows` is empty.
- [ ] `Neo.grid.Container#createColumns` and `Neo.grid.header.Wrapper#updateHeaders` avoid redundant `onColumnsMutate` passes and destroy replaced column / header button instances on runtime `grid.columns = ...` reassignment.
- [ ] `Neo.collection.Base#splice` checks `me._filters.some(f => f.effective)` once before the item loop, skipping per-item `isFilteredItem` calls when no filter is effective.
- [ ] `Neo.collection.Base#evaluateFilters` avoids cloning `items.slice()` when `this.filterMode === 'primitive'`.
- [ ] `examples/grid/bigData/GridContainer.mjs` and `MainStore.mjs` avoid redundant intermediate `clear(false)` and stale-column render passes on row/column count changes.
- [ ] Existing grid, collection, and store Playwright unit tests pass (`npx playwright test --config buildScripts/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`).

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.data.Store#initialChunkSize` defaults globally.
- Benchmark suite changes in `neomjs/benchmarks` (tracked separately in `neomjs/benchmarks`).
